id: 14_CO2 or Class D Fire Extinguishers with Laser Systems Which should you use Innova
title: 激光设备旁，选对灭火器（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/14_CO2 or Class D Fire Extinguishers with Laser Systems Which should you use Innova.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/14_CO2 or Class D Fire Extinguishers with Laser Systems Which should you use Innova（国内版）/src.py

points.K7: 带电设备着火用二氧化碳
points.K8: 金属着火用金属火灾灭火器
points.S3: 二氧化碳灭火器怎么用
points.S4: 金属火：不用水，不用二氧化碳

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机旁，两手各指一个灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laser cutting machine, pointing at two different fire extinguishers on either side.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：激光设备旁怎么选灭火器。
overlay: 激光设备旁，选对灭火器

shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器、金属火灾灭火器、闪电、金属块四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a carbon dioxide fire extinguisher with a horn, a metal fire extinguisher, a lightning bolt, and a metal ingot. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备和金属，灭火方法不一样。

shots.scene: 激光切割机控制柜冒出一股烟，阿杰慌张地抓起一个灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Smoke rises from the control cabinet of a laser cutting machine; the young male student panics and grabs the nearest fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 控制柜冒烟，阿杰抓起灭火器就要喷。

shots.scene: 小研按住他，指向墙上另一个灭火器和急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to a different extinguisher on the wall and the emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：先断电，再选对灭火器。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前歪头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot tilts its head in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 灭火器长得差不多，为什么要挑？

shots.scene: 访客们隔着观察窗兴奋地看激光切割
shots.prompt_en: Visitors excitedly watch laser cutting through a closed viewing window.
shots.narration: 大家都爱看激光切割。

shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上的灭火器给访客讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points out the wall-mounted fire extinguishers to the visitors.
shots.narration: 看热闹之前，先认认身边的灭火器。

shots.scene: 废料架旁一个黄色的金属火灾灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A yellow metal fire extinguisher stands next to a scrap metal rack. No people.
shots.narration: 这个车间备了两种灭火器。

shots.scene: 门边墙上挂着带喇叭筒的二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A red carbon dioxide fire extinguisher with a black discharge horn hangs on the wall by the door. No people.
shots.narration: 一种灭金属火，一种是二氧化碳的。

shots.scene: 激光机控制柜打开，里面是密密麻麻的电路板
shots.prompt_en: An open laser machine control cabinet full of circuit boards. No people.
shots.narration: 激光设备里，全是精密电子元件。

shots.scene: 白色粉末覆盖电路板，旁边一张长长的空白维修账单
shots.prompt_en: White powder covers the circuit boards, next to a long blank repair bill icon. No people.
shots.narration: 喷一身干粉，维修费就涨一大截。

shots.scene: 粉末遇到水汽图标，电路板上出现锈斑
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: powder residue meets moisture droplets and rust spots appear on the circuit board. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉残留吸了潮气，会腐蚀金属。

shots.scene: 老李皱眉清理满是粉末的设备
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer frowns while cleaning powder out of a machine cabinet.
shots.narration: 清理起来又难，设备可能就毁了。

shots.scene: 示意图：二氧化碳气体罩住火焰，把氧气挤走
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: carbon dioxide gas covers a flame and pushes the oxygen away. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳把氧气挤走，火就灭了。

shots.scene: 气体散去，电路板干干净净
shots.prompt_en: The gas clears away, leaving the circuit board clean with no residue. No people.
shots.narration: 之后它散掉了，不留残渣。

shots.scene: 天平一边一个二氧化碳灭火器，一边是一堆维修账单
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: one carbon dioxide extinguisher on one side, a pile of blank repair bills on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火器贵一些，

shots.scene: 几个二氧化碳灭火器图标，等于一张维修账单
shots.prompt_en: Several carbon dioxide extinguisher icons equal to one blank repair bill. No people.
shots.narration: 可一次干粉的损失，够买好几个。

shots.section_title: 带电设备着火用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 带闪电标志的控制柜旁，挂着二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher mounted next to an electrical control cabinet with a lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备着火，首选二氧化碳。
overlay: 带电设备着火用二氧化碳

shots.section_title: 金属着火用金属火灾灭火器
shots.scene: 钛合金板材图标上冒出白亮的火焰
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a titanium alloy sheet burning with a bright white flame. No people.
shots.narration: 钛等金属也会燃烧。
overlay: 金属着火用金属火灾灭火器

shots.section_title: 金属着火用金属火灾灭火器
shots.scene: 黄色的金属火灾灭火器特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a yellow metal fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 金属火很难扑灭，要用专门的灭火器。

shots.scene: 六个图标：木头、油桶、气瓶、金属块、闪电、炒锅
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a row: wood, an oil drum, a gas cylinder, a metal ingot, a lightning bolt, and a frying pan. No people.
shots.narration: 我国把火灾分为六类。

shots.scene: 金属块和闪电两个图标被放大
shots.prompt_en: The metal ingot and lightning bolt icons are enlarged and highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 激光车间常见的是金属火和带电火。

shots.scene: 王老师指着灭火器上的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the blank label on an extinguisher.
shots.narration: 看清灭火器标签，适用哪类火。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下切割机的红色急停按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the red emergency stop button on the laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 带电设备着火，先按急停。

shots.scene: 老李拉下配电箱的总闸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls down the main switch on the electrical panel.
shots.narration: 能断总电源的，马上断电。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器怎么用
shots.scene: 小研提起二氧化碳灭火器，拔掉保险销
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts a carbon dioxide extinguisher and pulls out the safety pin.
shots.narration: 提起灭火器，拔掉保险销。
overlay: 二氧化碳灭火器怎么用

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器怎么用
shots.scene: 小研握住喇叭筒的手柄，对准火焰根部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the insulated handle of the horn and aims at the base of the fire.
shots.narration: 握住手柄，对准火焰根部压下。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器怎么用
shots.scene: 手握金属喇叭筒的图标，被红叉划掉，旁边有雪花
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand gripping the metal horn, with a snowflake, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 喇叭筒极冷，别直接握，会冻伤。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器怎么用
shots.scene: 狭小房间里充满二氧化碳，人形图标头晕
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small closed room filling with carbon dioxide and a person icon feeling dizzy. No people.
shots.narration: 狭小房间大量喷放，人会缺氧窒息。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器怎么用
shots.scene: 灭火后小研退出房间，打开门窗通风
shots.prompt_en: After the fire is out, the female graduate student leaves the room and opens the doors and windows.
shots.narration: 灭火后先撤出，通风后再进去。

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水，不用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 水泼向燃烧金属的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water thrown onto burning metal, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 金属着火，绝不能用水。
overlay: 金属火：不用水，不用二氧化碳

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水，不用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 二氧化碳喷向燃烧金属的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a carbon dioxide extinguisher spraying burning metal, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳也不行，会更危险。

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水，不用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 金属火灾灭火器和一桶干沙
shots.prompt_en: A yellow metal fire extinguisher and a bucket of dry sand. No people.
shots.narration: 用专用灭火器或干沙覆盖。

shots.section_title: 金属火：不用水，不用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 阿杰拨打电话，大大的119图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls on a phone, with a large icon showing 119.
shots.narration: 没把握就别扑，撤离并拨打119。

shots.scene: 老李查看灭火器压力表，指针在绿区
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the pressure gauge on an extinguisher; the needle is in the green zone.
shots.narration: 定期查压力、看有效期。

shots.scene: 灭火器挂在醒目位置，上方有灭火器标志，前面没有杂物
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher hangs in a visible spot with a fire extinguisher sign above it and nothing blocking it. No people.
shots.narration: 放在明处，不挡不藏。

shots.scene: 老李在空白检查卡上签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer signs a blank inspection tag hanging on the extinguisher.
shots.narration: 检查后签卡，用过马上换新。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现急停、二氧化碳灭火器、金属灭火器、干沙、119五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: an emergency stop button, a carbon dioxide extinguisher, a metal fire extinguisher, a sand bucket, and a phone with 119.
shots.narration: 先断电，带电火用二氧化碳。

shots.scene: 小研握着手柄，对着火焰根部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the handle and aims at the base of a small fire.
shots.narration: 金属火用专用器材，防冻防窒息。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研、老李站在灭火器旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the female graduate student and the facility engineer beside the fire extinguishers.
shots.narration: 选对灭火器，关键时刻不慌。
